shortDescription: Manage key material on a tang server

options.name: cachedir
options.description: Absolute path to the on-disk cache directory used by older tang releases. Ignored when I(update) does not exist.

options.name: force
options.description: Always create new keys, even if the key directory already contains keys.

options.name: keydir
options.description: Absolute path to the directory holding the tang keys.

options.name: keygen
options.description: Absolute path to the C(tangd-keygen) helper used to create new keys. Required for C(keys-created), C(keys-rotated) and C(keys-deployed).

options.name: keys_to_deploy_dir
options.description: Directory on the managed node holding the C(*.jwk) files to deploy. Required for C(state=keys-deployed).

options.name: state
options.description: Operation to perform. C(keys-created) generates new keys when the key directory has no visible keys yet. Existing keys are kept untouched. C(keys-rotated) renames every visible C(*.jwk) file in the key directory to a hidden C(.*.jwk) file and then creates a fresh set of keys. Hidden keys continue to be honoured by tang for existing clients but are no longer advertised. C(keys-deployed) copies all C(*.jwk) files from I(keys_to_deploy_dir) into the key directory and rotates any conflicting keys. C

options.name: update
options.description: Absolute path to the C(tangd-update) helper used to update the on-disk cache. When the path does not exist the cache update step is silently skipped.
